# galaxy_live_tables (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `result` (Attributes List) A page of results. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result))

<a id="nestedatt--result"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result`

Read-Only:

- `catalog_id` (String) ID of the table publisher catalog, a Glue or Galaxy metastore catalog. Absent when the table is only served by a Galaxy REST metastore catalog
- `catalog_name` (String) Name of the catalog supplying the table's storage location: the table publisher catalog if set, otherwise the Galaxy REST metastore catalog
- `cloud_region_id` (String) Region in which the table is stored
- `data_retention_days` (Number) If configured, data older than dataRetentionDays is deleted from Iceberg; otherwise, data is kept forever
- `description` (String) Table description
- `error_notification_count` (Number) Number of undismissed error notifications in the last five days
- `failure_mode` (String) Failure mode.
- `galaxy_rest_catalog_id` (String) ID of the Galaxy REST metastore catalog serving the table, if any
- `live_table_id` (String) Table ID
- `live_table_state` (String) Table state
- `schema_name` (String) Name of the table's schema
- `snapshot_retention_days` (Number) Number of days to retain table snapshots; older snapshots are automatically removed during maintenance
- `stop_message` (String) Message explaining why the table was stopped
- `stop_type` (String) Type of stop event if table is stopped
- `table_name` (String) Table name
- `type_properties` (Attributes) Type-specific live table properties (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties))
- `warn_notification_count` (Number) Number of undismissed warning notifications in the last five days

<a id="nestedatt--result--type_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.type_properties`

Read-Only:

- `columns` (Attributes List) Output columns and the expressions that produce their values (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--columns))
- `csv_parameters` (Attributes) CSV format parameters. Required for CSV format, must be absent for other formats (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--csv_parameters))
- `fanout_columns` (Attributes List) Fans the table's output out into one sink table per distinct combination of these column values, instead of a single output table. Order is part of the route's identity, and the columns cannot be changed once the table exists (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--fanout_columns))
- `file_format` (String) File format
- `file_ingest_source_id` (String) ID of the file ingest source obtained from the /fileIngestSource endpoint
- `filter_expressions` (List of String) Filter predicates over the input table's columns; at most one is supported
- `kafka_ingest_source_id` (String) ID of the Kafka ingest source obtained from the /kafkaIngestSource endpoint
- `kafka_topic_name` (String) Kafka topic name
- `latency_mode` (String) Latency mode for commits
- `live_table_id` (String) ID of the source table
- `partition_max_bytes_per_sec` (Number) Throughput limit per partition
- `path_suffix` (String) Suffix to append to the name from ingest source
- `polling_interval_in_minutes` (Number) List files in object storage every polling interval
- `schema_registry_id` (String) Schema registry id associated with the live table
- `sort_column_name` (String) Sort column
- `start_strategy` (String) Stream start strategy
- `subject_name` (String) Subject name in the schema registry
- `type_key` (String)
- `user_defined_partition_spec` (Attributes List) Custom partition spec for transform live tables (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--user_defined_partition_spec))
- `user_defined_schema` (Attributes List) Schema of the transformed table (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--user_defined_schema))

<a id="nestedatt--result--type_properties--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.type_properties.columns`

Read-Only:

- `column_id` (Number) ID of the transform column
- `expression` (String) Trino SQL expression producing this column's value; present only for top-level columns
- `nested_columns` (Attributes List) Nested columns for complex types (Row, Map, Array) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--columns--nested_columns))
- `trino_column_name` (String) Column name
- `trino_type` (Attributes) Column type; adheres to Trino conventions (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--columns--trino_type))

<a id="nestedatt--result--type_properties--columns--nested_columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.type_properties.columns.nested_columns`

Read-Only:

- `column_id` (Number) ID of the transform column
- `expression` (String) Trino SQL expression producing this column's value; present only for top-level columns
- `nested_columns` (String) Nested columns for complex types (Row, Map, Array)
Encoded as a JSON string because this type is recursive.
- `trino_column_name` (String) Column name
- `trino_type` (Attributes) Column type; adheres to Trino conventions (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--columns--nested_columns--trino_type))

<a id="nestedatt--result--type_properties--columns--nested_columns--trino_type"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.type_properties.columns.nested_columns.trino_type`

Read-Only:

- `type_id` (String) Trino type enum
- `type_parameters` (Map of String) Parameters for completing the type specification.
Types Decimal, Time, Timestamp, and TimestampTz require a parameter named `precision`, which is the number of digits.
Type Decimal also requires a parameter named `scale`, which is the number of digits to the right of the decimal point.

Read-Only:

- `type_id` (String) Trino type enum
- `type_parameters` (Map of String) Parameters for completing the type specification.
Types Decimal, Time, Timestamp, and TimestampTz require a parameter named `precision`, which is the number of digits.
Type Decimal also requires a parameter named `scale`, which is the number of digits to the right of the decimal point.

### Nested Schema for `result.type_properties.csv_parameters`

Read-Only:

- `delimiter` (String) CSV delimiter character
- `escape_char` (String) CSV escape character
- `num_header_lines_to_exclude` (Number) Number of CSV header lines to exclude

<a id="nestedatt--result--type_properties--fanout_columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.type_properties.fanout_columns`

Read-Only:

- `transform` (String) Transform applied to the column value to form the route
- `trino_column_name` (String) Name of the column to route on, from IngestColumn or NewIngestColumn


<a id="nestedatt--result--type_properties--user_defined_partition_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.type_properties.user_defined_partition_spec`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_count` (Number) Bucket count when transformType=bucket
- `transform_type` (String) One of {identity, year, month, day, hour, bucket, truncate, void}
- `trino_column_name` (String) Column name from IngestColumn or NewIngestColumn
- `truncate_width` (Number) Width when transformType=truncate


<a id="nestedatt--result--type_properties--user_defined_schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.type_properties.user_defined_schema`

Read-Only:

- `column_id` (Number) ID of the transform column
- `field_parser_config` (Attributes) JSON pointer (and parsing parameters) to the raw-table field transformed into this column value (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--user_defined_schema--field_parser_config))
- `nested_columns` (Attributes List) Nested columns for complex types (Row, Map, Array).
For primitive types, this list is empty.
For the Row type, this contains the fields of the row.
For the Map type, this contains the key and value types.
For the Array type, this contains the single element type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--user_defined_schema--nested_columns))
- `trino_column_name` (String) Name of the transform column; adheres to Trino conventions
- `trino_type` (Attributes) Column type; adheres to Trino conventions (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--user_defined_schema--trino_type))

<a id="nestedatt--result--type_properties--user_defined_schema--field_parser_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.type_properties.user_defined_schema.field_parser_config`

Read-Only:

- `parse_parameters` (Map of String) Parameters for parsing Varchar and time types.
For Varchar, the only allowed parameter is "varchar.type", with valid values "scalar" or "json".
For Timestamp and TimestampTz, the only allowed parameters are:
  - "timestamp.converter", with valid values "unixtime" or "iso8601".
  - "timestamp.unit", with valid values "nanos", "micros", "millis", "secs", "mins", "hours", or "days".
- `pointer` (String) JSON pointer (IETF RFC 6901)


<a id="nestedatt--result--type_properties--user_defined_schema--nested_columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.type_properties.user_defined_schema.nested_columns`

Read-Only:

- `field_parser_config` (Attributes) JSON pointer (and parsing parameters) to the raw-table field transformed into this column value (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--type_properties--user_defined_schema--nested_columns--field_parser_config))
- `nested_columns` (String) Nested columns for complex types (Row, Map, Array).
For primitive types, this list is empty.
For the Row type, this contains the fields of the row.
For the Map type, this contains the key and value types.
For the Array type, this contains the single element type.

Encoded as a JSON string because this type is recursive.
